description: The class of every ECC v2.2.3 command, from part 2 of the command adaptation map. A: deterministic rewrites only, registered as /ecc-<name>. B: needs a Kiro-native rewrite, which an overlay in overlays/ delivers; a B command without a current overlay is pending, and every B command now has one. C: cannot work with the installed set; plan-canvas is the only one left, and it is left to the skill of the same name. `skill` names an installed skill that gives the same entry, so the command is not registered. `builtin` marks a command the engine builds itself. For B and C, `reason` says what in the ECC text is Claude-specific or missing and `missing` says what has to be supplied.

auto-update.missing: a Kiro-native overlay on top of ecc-kiro.mjs doctor, plan --action update and update (the update action exists).

cost-report.missing: a Kiro-native overlay over usage-report.mjs, which the owned part installs to .kiro/ecc/scripts/ (cost and skills reports over Kiro's local session log).
